purpose: Runtime atlas containing 120 true player turnaround frames at three-degree intervals for shooting-direction changes.
camera: fixed top-down three-quarter orthographic camera; one stable model rotates only around its vertical axis
facing: frame 0 faces right; 120 clockwise frames cover 0 through 357 degrees in three-degree steps
lighting: approved A tactical illustration rendered through eight aligned view projections with adjacent-view blending
prompt: Generate one stable Hunyuan3D 2.1 player mesh from the approved A tactical illustration reference using seed 20260805, 30 diffusion steps, and 256 octree resolution. Align the eight approved front, rear, side, and diagonal views to the model projection, rotate that same model at exact three-degree intervals in Godot, blend adjacent approved views, crop against transparent background, and pack row-major into a 12x10 atlas.
negative_constraints: no planar screen rotation presented as a body turn
no identity, armor, palette, proportion, or lighting drift
no opaque background fallback or frame clipping
no collision, weapon-angle, movement, or damage changes

references.role: single stable 3D geometry source for every frame

generation_model: Hunyuan3D-2.1 shape plus deterministic Godot eight-view projection renderer
